about.heading: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Frontend-focused SDE with 1.5+ years of experience owning and shipping production-grade React Native and React applications at scale. At Spinny, I delivered 10+ features and took ownership across 3 internal products and 1 B2B app, reduced app crashes by 98%, and cut build times by 50%.
about.bioExtended: I consistently drive measurable performance improvements and take full ownership of domains end-to-end. I'm also an effective user of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity) to significantly accelerate delivery and optimize workflows.
